subject: ist-pt
title: IST.PT.------MN.DI.
description: Chart on book p. 364 (R(AS)CM(II)-8). IST-PT (isolated particulars) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names MN-DI (mono-dimensional); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: MN-DU, INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and OP-SD (option spread). From INTR: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From OP-SD: POST (postulation). From SOC-RT-DY: P-PROG (particular progressionalism). From T-C-IMP: RT-ALGN (reality alignment) and TR-DIF (trans-definition). From P-PROG: POL-P (political policies). From RT-ALGN: RET-AF-TD (retrograde affinity tendencies).
